title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. translated_title: GMTS：基于梯度幅值的词元选择改进大语言模型推理的RLVR训练
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL），特别是带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），近来已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的核心范式，在各种推理任务上展现出显著的有效性。近期研究表明，高熵词元在模型训练中扮演着极其重要的角色，因为仅使用熵值最高的20%词元进行训练就能带来显著的性能提升。然而，为什么这类高熵词元如此有益，目前仍缺乏充分的理解。在本工作中，我们发现虽然同一答案内的高熵词元往往与较大的梯度幅值相关，但考虑到答案级奖励信号的差异，仅凭熵值无法在不同答案之间一致地反映词元的重要性。基于这一观察，我们提出了基于梯度幅值的词元选择（GMTS）方法来量化词元的重要性，该方法利用……
tldr: 该论文发现熵值无法在不同答案间一致地反映词元重要性，据此提出基于梯度幅值的词元选择方法GMTS来量化词元重要性，从而改进大语言模型推理的RLVR训练。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, and proposes GMTS, a gradient magnitude-based token selection method, to quantify token importance and thereby improve RLVR training for LLM reasoning.
